# Housekeeping Cart Stocking and Safety Inspection Log
Shift: Morning Shift (07:00 - 15:30)
Attendant: Elena Cruz
Floor Assignment: Floor 4 (Rooms 401-424)
Cart Unit: C-08
Date: 04/14/2026

## Equipment and Inventory Baseline
| Item Category | Standard Specification | Stock Count | Cart Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bath Sheets | White Terry 30x58 in | 24 ea | 30 ea |
| Hand Towels | White Terry 16x30 in | 30 ea | 35 ea |
| Multi-Surface Disinfectant | 32 oz spray bottle (RTU) | 2 ea | 4 ea |
| Glass Cleaner | 32 oz spray bottle (RTU) | 2 ea | 3 ea |
| Cart Wheel Castors | 8-inch non-marking swivel | 4 ea | 4 ea |
| Total Load Weight | Linens, liquids, dry paper | 165 lb | 220 lb |

## Morning Loading Checklist
- Check all 4 castor wheels for thread entanglements, debris, and smooth rotation.
- Verify bottom shelf linen stack does not exceed the 15-inch rail clearance.
- Disinfectant chemical spray bottles placed in exterior side caddy without secondary GHS safety labels affixed.
- Ensure vinyl trash collection bag is emptied and hooked to the push bar.
- Inspect push-handle height and report loose hardware to maintenance immediately.

## Restocking and Chemical Safety Protocols
- Restock clean linens on middle and lower shelves; distribute weight evenly across the wheel base.
- Store quaternary ammonium disinfectant in the lower side caddy below eye level.
- Do not exceed manufacturer cart payload rating of 350 lb under any circumstances.
- Maintain clear visibility over top tray when pushing; never stack amenities higher than 48 inches from floor.
- Park cart tight against the guest room wall on the corridor side being serviced.

errors.quote: spray bottles placed in exterior side caddy without secondary GHS safety labels affixed
errors.explanation: OSHA Hazard Communication Standard requires secondary chemical spray containers transferred from concentrates or bulk to have compliant GHS workplace labeling identifying product name and hazard warnings.
errors.fix: spray bottles placed in exterior side caddy with secondary GHS safety labels affixed

errors.quote: Do not exceed manufacturer cart payload rating of 350 lb under any circumstances.
errors.explanation: The reference table specifies that the cart payload limit for Cart C-08 is 220 lb, not 350 lb.
errors.fix: Do not exceed manufacturer cart payload rating of 220 lb under any circumstances.
